summary: SignIn/SignUp use forceRedirectUrl, breaking admin session-ceiling redirect_url propagation
description:
## Symptom

Hitting /admin on the tailnet hostname (guru-web-prod.tailb5626e.ts.net) when the Clerk session is older than 1 hour bounces the user to /chat instead of forcing a fresh sign-in and returning to /admin. Reproduced live during the 2026-05-09 production cutover.

## Root cause

src/middleware.ts:50-57 enforces a 1-hour session ceiling on /admin paths: when iat > 1h old it redirects to /sign-in?redirect_url=/admin. But:

- src/app/sign-in/[[...sign-in]]/page.tsx:18 — `<SignIn signUpUrl="/sign-up" forceRedirectUrl="/chat" />`
- src/app/sign-up/[[...sign-up]]/page.tsx:18 — `<SignUp signInUrl="/sign-in" forceRedirectUrl="/chat" />`

`forceRedirectUrl` is the Clerk prop that ALWAYS wins over the redirect_url query param. So the redirect_url emitted by middleware is dead code — Clerk reads it, ignores it, sends the user to /chat per forceRedirectUrl.

## Fix

Swap both `forceRedirectUrl` to `fallbackRedirectUrl`:

- forceRedirectUrl   → always go here, even if redirect_url is set
- fallbackRedirectUrl → only go here if redirect_url is NOT set

Direct sign-in / sign-up flows have no redirect_url in the URL, so /chat still wins for them via the fallback. Only the admin re-auth path (which is the one currently broken) sets redirect_url, and that's what we want to honor.

## Test

Add a vitest case in src/__tests__/admin.test.ts (or a new file alongside it) that asserts: given a session with iat > ADMIN_SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS, middleware emits a redirect to /sign-in with redirect_url=/admin in the query string. (The Clerk-side prop change isn't unit-testable from our side; covering the middleware contract is enough.)

Also worth a manual smoke test post-fix: sign in, wait 61 minutes (or shorten ADMIN_SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS to 60s in dev), hit /admin, confirm the round-trip lands on /admin not /chat.
